# Vendored front-end libraries (offline, no CDN)

Downloaded once and committed so Sirens runs with no network.
Do not replace these with CDN links.

| File | Library | Version | Licence | Downloaded from |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| htmx.min.js | htmx | 2.0.11 | 0BSD | unpkg.com/htmx.org@2.0.11/dist/htmx.min.js |
| chart.umd.js | Chart.js | 4.5.1 | MIT |  unpkg.com/chart.js@4.5.1/dist/chart.umd.js |

To upgrade: download the new file, replace it here, update this table,
then re-test the pages that use it with the network turned off.
